categories.main_business_segments: Donaldson Company operates through three primary segments: Mobile Solutions (62.1% of FY25 net sales), Industrial Solutions (29.9%), and Life Sciences (8.0%). Mobile Solutions includes Off-Road, On-Road, and Aftermarket filtration products for vehicles and equipment. Industrial Solutions covers industrial air filtration, gases, hydraulics, power generation, and aerospace/defense. Life Sciences focuses on filtration for food and beverage, disk drives, vehicle electrification, medical devices, microelectronics, and bioprocessing.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Donaldson leverages advanced filtration technologies such as PowerCore, Ultra-Web, Synteq XP, Alpha-Web, and proprietary membrane and chromatography products. Manufacturing is global, with 77 manufacturing/distribution centers, and emphasizes in-house R&D, process improvement, and material science innovation. The company utilizes both traditional and connected (IoT-enabled) filtration systems, and has expanded into bioprocessing equipment and consumables through recent acquisitions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include OEMs in construction, mining, agriculture, transportation, and aerospace, as well as independent distributors, dealer networks, and direct end users. Major end markets span heavy-duty vehicles, industrial manufacturing, power generation, food and beverage processing, electronics, and life sciences (including bioprocessing and medical devices). No single customer accounts for more than 10% of sales, but many operate in cyclical industries.
categories.geographic_coverage: Donaldson operates in over 150 locations across six continents. FY25 revenue was distributed as follows: U.S. and Canada (44.2%), EMEA (27.8%), Asia Pacific (17.2%), and Latin America (10.8%). The company maintains manufacturing, distribution, and R&D facilities globally, supporting a diversified regional presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: Donaldson primarily operates as a midstream and downstream supplier, providing filtration components, systems, and aftermarket parts to OEMs, distributors, and end users. The company sources raw materials such as steel, filter media, and petrochemical-based products, and adds value through design, manufacturing, and service.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include extending market access (notably in bioprocessing and alternative power), expanding technology and service offerings (including connected/IoT solutions), and pursuing strategic acquisitions in high-margin areas. R&D focuses on material science, digital integration, sustainability, and disruptive filtration technologies, with $87.8 million spent in FY25 (2.4% of net sales).
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of filtration products, systems, and replacement parts, with additional income from aftermarket services, equipment, and limited installation and consulting. Sales channels include direct sales, OEM partnerships, distributors, and e-commerce. Service and aftermarket sales are a significant recurring revenue stream.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Donaldson faces competition from large global and regional filtration companies across all segments. It is a market leader in several product lines, particularly Off-Road and On-Road OEM filtration and aftermarket replacement filters. Competition is based on technology, innovation, performance, service, price, and geographic reach.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In FY25, Donaldson reported net sales of $3.69 billion, up 2.9% from the prior year, with net earnings of $367 million. The company maintains strong cash flow, a global footprint, and a diversified revenue base. Growth was led by the Life Sciences segment (9.8% increase), with stable performance in Mobile and Industrial Solutions. The company continues to invest in R&D, acquisitions, and capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Donaldson differentiates itself through advanced, proprietary filtration technologies, high product reliability, and the ability to meet stringent technical requirements. Its global service network, strong OEM relationships, and focus on innovation and sustainability provide added value. The company emphasizes solutions that enhance equipment performance, reduce downtime, and support regulatory and environmental compliance.
